You are calculating the dose of a drug called Rendaxin for a hospital pharmacy.
You will be given information about the patient. Calculate the dose according to the protocol below.

Protocol:
- Base value = Body weight (kg) × 20
- If Creatinine clearance (mL/min) is 60 or above, the coefficient is 1.0; if it is between 30 and 59, the coefficient is 0.5; if it is below 30, the coefficient is 0.25.
- dose = base value × coefficient. Round the result to the nearest multiple of 50; if it is exactly halfway, round up. Unit: mg.
- The protocol uses only the Body weight (kg) and Creatinine clearance (mL/min) values.

The work consists of two stages.
1. Calculation stage: For each case, give your answer only in this JSON format:
{"value": <integer>}
2. Evaluation stage: After the message "The calculation stage is over", answer the questions you are asked in free text.
